quote: We propose a Modality Split learning and Ensemble inference framework, MoSE, for multimodal knowledge graph completion task.
To evaluate MoSE, four metrics are used, i.e., Hits@K, K=1, 3, 10, representing accuracy in top K predictions, and Mean Rank (MR).
